observations: Photo 0 shows a single wooden pallet on a concrete floor; light-colored wood with visible knots and some dark spots.
Photo 1 shows the same pallet from a different angle; top deck boards and stringers are visible; no clear pallet brand markings.
Photo 2 shows multiple stacked pallets (dark and light) in an outdoor/yard setting; some boards look worn and uneven.

claims.claim: Wooden pallets are the backbone of supply chain logistics, manufacturing, and warehousing, while...
claims.evidence: Seller text is generic and not testable from photos.

claims.claim: Everything is clean, dry and sorted, no water added.
claims.evidence: Photos show pallets on a floor, but cannot confirm dryness, whether any water was added, or whether they are fully sorted by grade.

claims.claim: Weighed at 500 kg on a certified scale this morning.
claims.evidence: No scale ticket/receipt or weighing photo is shown; photos do not confirm total quantity or total weight.

risks.risk: Total quantity/weight may not be 500 kg (photos show at least one pallet clearly and multiple stacked pallets, but not enough to verify the full lot weight).
risks.proof: A clear photo/video of the certified scale reading with the full pallet lot on it (or a scale ticket/receipt showing date/time and weight).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a smaller, worst-case lot (not guaranteed 500 kg).

risks.risk: Pallet condition/grade may vary (some boards look worn/darker in photo 2; could be mixed quality).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of multiple pallets showing cracks, broken boards, missing nails, and underside condition; include at least 3 pallets from the stack.
risks.if_unproven: Price as mixed/used pallets with possible wear (not premium/undamaged).

risks.risk: Moisture/odor/infestation risk (seller claims 'clean, dry' but photos cannot confirm moisture content or pest treatment).
risks.proof: Moisture meter reading (if available) or photos of pallet ends/underside plus a short video showing no wetness; also ask if they are heat-treated (HT) or fumigated (MB) and show any stamp.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed dry/treated (assume standard used pallets).

risks.risk: Potential non-standard pallet size or incomplete deck (could affect usability and resale).
risks.proof: Measure and photograph length/width/height of one pallet (tape measure in frame) and show underside stringers.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic pallets with unknown dimensions.

proof_requests: Photo/video of the certified scale reading with the entire lot (or a scale receipt/ticket).
Close-up photos of at least 3 pallets: top deck, underside, and end grain (show any cracks/broken boards).
Any pallet stamps/markings (HT/MB/IPPC) photographed clearly if present.
One pallet measurement with tape (length x width x height) and underside view.
response.reason: From the photos, the item appears to be wooden pallets, but the key pricing drivers in the seller’s words (total weight/500 kg and condition being clean/dry/sorted) are not verifiable remotely without scale proof and condition/grade evidence.
